:x: <registry-dir>/projects.config.json: project "gamma" has no "driver", and DAYTONA_API_URL without SANDBOX_DRIVER made Daytona this installation's default, but the Daytona sandbox driver was removed and "ssh-docker" is the only driver — to move it, give it "driver": "ssh-docker" or set SANDBOX_DRIVER=ssh-docker and restart (docs/sandbox-drivers.md → Moving a project to ssh-docker), or keep running the last release that has the Daytona driver
_The previous config stays active._
